title: Tandza
description: N’wangwenya, N’waxibodze, N’waphengwini na N’wahuku va kuma tandza. Xana i tandza ra vona? ‘I tandza ra hina,’ ku vula manana na tatana hi ku tinyungubyisa ekuheteleleni. Kumisisa leswaku xana i tandza ra mani.
